name: Soft-Impute
model_likelihood: Observed-entry squared reconstruction loss for a low-rank target matrix
prior: Nuclear-norm penalty lambda*sum(singular values); no Bayesian prior specified
inference_algorithm: Iterative singular-value soft-thresholding of observed X plus current missing-entry predictions; warm-start a decreasing lambda path
estimand: Fitted completed matrices Zhat_lambda along the regularization path
data_input: Observed entries of X and index set Omega
tunable_settings: lambda >= 0 and its grid; relative iterate-change stopping tolerance
